title: Five Flower Arrows
source_seed: Seed: the sugarcane bow and five flower arrows, the five senses (Sahasranama verses on her four arms; Kama's weapons in her hands per Vedadhara). Invented symbol: the arrows rising from the water as glowing flowers.
logline: Five glowing flower arrows rise from the water into the air above her open palms, and she sends them up into the sky where they bloom as five bright stars.
story: Five glowing flower arrows rise from the water into the air above her open palms, and she sends them up into the sky where they bloom as five bright stars. Seed: the sugarcane bow and five flower arrows, the five senses (Sahasranama verses on her four arms; Kama's weapons in her hands per Vedadhara). Invented symbol: the arrows rising from the water as glowing flowers.
loop: The light settles and she rests in the frame-1 smile.
audio: Eerie and solemn: low drone, bowed tone, deep frame drums building faster at the payoff; tempo from the director (rule 8).

shots.camera: Eye level, front-facing, the tall crown and crescent moon centered and fully framed, full-length framing, steady.
shots.action: Five glowing flower arrows rise from the dark water in a tight line and float up to hover above Her open palms, their petals glowing rose-gold and lighting Her smiling face. Her hair settles under natural gravity.
shots.purpose: The five weapons of desire gather in her hands, not Kama's.

shots.camera: The camera holds at eye level, the crown centered and fully framed.
shots.action: Her palms tilt upward and the five arrows shoot gracefully into the twilight sky, where each blooms into a bright star, and soft light falls back over the water below. Her hair settles under natural gravity.
shots.purpose: She releases the five senses as stars: desire mastered, turned to light.
